_comment: Authoritative org guardrail policy, versioned in the platform repo and shipped with every console deployment. New projects inherit the default pack automatically; domain and project overrides may add or strengthen guardrails but can never remove org defaults. Exemptions require a 4-eyes platform review.

guardrails.name: PII content filter
guardrails.description: Detects and blocks personally identifiable information in prompts and responses before they leave the agent boundary.

guardrails.name: Security scan CI gate
guardrails.description: Every exported project pipeline runs a secret and dependency scan; releases are blocked on findings.

domainOptions.name: Customer-facing tone review
domainOptions.description: Adds a tone-of-voice review step for customer-facing agents.

domainOptions.name: Strict PII re-check (on top of the org baseline)
domainOptions.description: Second-pass PII detection with a stricter threshold than the org default.

domainOptions.name: Extra rate-limit guardrail
domainOptions.description: Per-session request ceiling beyond the platform quota.

domainOptions.name: Multilingual eval CI step
domainOptions.description: Runs the golden dataset in every supported locale before promotion.

catalog.name: PII Detection
catalog.description: Screens user input for personally identifiable information.

catalog.name: Harmful Content
catalog.description: Filters violent, hateful or otherwise harmful material.

catalog.name: Jailbreaking
catalog.description: Detects attempts to override the agent's system instructions.

catalog.name: Prompt Injection
catalog.description: Detects instructions smuggled through retrieved or user-supplied content.

catalog.name: Topic Restriction
catalog.description: Flags responses that stray outside the agent's approved topics.

enforcement.orgDefaults: Org defaults are locked on for every project; they cannot be removed or weakened at any level.
enforcement.domainAdditions: Domain leads may enforce additional guardrails for their domain; additions are strengthen-only.
enforcement.projectConfiguration: Projects compose the configurable controls (action, run mode, priority, message) when exporting a workspace.
enforcement.exemptions: A guardrail exemption is time-boxed and requires an independent platform reviewer (4-eyes); it never removes an org default silently.
